sentences.text: Honest is the second studio album by American rapper Future .	Future	Future (rapper)	Honest	Honest (song)	studio album	studio album
It was released on April 22 , 2014 , by A1 Recordings , Freebandz and Epic Records .	A1	A1 Records	Freebandz	Freebandz	Epic	Epic Records	A1 Recordings	A1 Records	Epic Records	Epic Records
The album features guest appearances from Drake and Wiz Khalifa , among others .	Drake	Drake (musician)	Wiz Khalifa	Wiz Khalifa

The album was supported by five singles : `` Karate Chop '' featuring Lil Wayne , `` Honest '' , `` Shit '' , `` Move That Dope '' featuring Pharrell , Pusha T and Casino , and `` I Won '' featuring Kanye West , along with the promotional single `` Real and True '' featuring Mr Hudson and Miley Cyrus .
